headline: Adani Airports raises $300 million; Natco Pharma receives FDA observations; NSEL settles long-standing payment default

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Adani Airports secured $300 million in equity funding from 360 ONE Asset, bringing total funding to $1.35 billion.
Natco Pharma's formulation unit was issued seven observations by the U.S. FDA following an inspection.
NSEL ended a 14-year payment default by releasing ₹1,950 crore in a one-time settlement.
US markets surged significantly as Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, boosting global sentiment.
whatHappening: Adani Group's airport division continues to attract major equity investment for its infrastructure projects.
Regulatory scrutiny has increased for Natco Pharma following the U.S. FDA's findings at its formulation facility.
Nasscom has proposed a three-year AI Transformation Scheme for inclusion in the upcoming Union Budget.
IRDAI has restructured the Insurance Ombudsman system review panel to improve the grievance redressal framework.
summary: Adani Airports raised $300 million from 360 ONE Asset, strengthening its equity base to $1.35 billion. Natco Pharma faced regulatory pressure after receiving seven U.S. FDA observations for its formulation unit. Meanwhile, NSEL resolved a decade-long payment default with a ₹1,950 crore settlement.
